title: Concept: Kafka management UI in a response
description: A Kafka management UI in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The UI lists topics, consumer groups and message payloads, so it exposes the integration contracts and the business events flowing between services.
applicability: Deployments that render a Kafka management UI into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The UI lists topics, consumer groups and message payloads, so it exposes the integration contracts and the business events flowing between services.
